## Convx 2.0.2 Nightly

Pre-release build from `main`. Nightly builds may be unstable. Please report issues in the Convx GitHub issue tracker.

### New in 2.0.2
- Fixed a crash during playback (`IllegalArgumentException` from the playback-stats tracker). A bad stats event is now dropped instead of closing the app.

### Also included from 2.0.1
- Playlist import and library fixes.
- Feed refresh and pagination fixes.
- Reliability improvements across playback, navigation, lyrics, and appearance settings.
